flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (upgrade, both ways checked): stored riverview. Campspot sells six sites as type 'Waterfront Site' - Sites 09, 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14 (33, 33, 32, 35, 36, 32 ft), all nightly ($35, 7-night maximum). On the Campspot park map these are the outer row on the south side of the loop, facing away from the loop road; the inner row (Sites 06-08) and Sites 01-05 and 15 are inside or north of the loop. On imagery (z19 tiles) the south spurs end about 10-20 m from the river bank over open mowed lawn, with no road between; a picnic shelter and small parking area sit on the lawn near Sites 10-11. The Campspot photos of Site 09 and Site 11 show the pad, a table, then open grass straight to the water's edge. Approximate centre of the waterfront row (imagery estimate): 45.6757,-94.8070. The water here is the Sauk River below the Melrose dam: the channel measures about 17-27 m wide on imagery along the sites, under the ~30 m line, so by the width rule the value would be `creekside` (riverfront if the reviewer goes by the river's size upstream - the impoundment above the dam is far wider). With 6 of 15 sites clearly on the water, AWH's 2026-11-10 rule ('a few clear waterfront sites count') supports an upgrade with a caveat naming Sites 9-14. Not changed by this result.
